state.portfolio: A photography portfolio visitor wants to open a project. Large static screenshot shows a carousel arrow but does not respond. A separate small text link works.
state.configurator: A furniture configurator embeds the actual live configurator at native size. Its controls work, keyboard focus is verified and visitors must try colors here before deciding.
state.editorial: An editorial article shows a historical software screenshot to explain a discontinued interface. There is no live destination and the image is clearly captioned as an archival screenshot.
state.checkout: Checkout shows an item thumbnail beside explicit remove and quantity buttons. The visitor must review the order and pay; there is no external demo to explore.
state.mobile_crop: A read-only product preview already links clearly to the live demo. On mobile the source hero image bottom and primary action are outside the frame.
state.unknown: A landing page is described as premium. No screenshot, DOM observation, visitor task or behavior evidence is available.

portfolio.instructions: For case `portfolio`, select the intervention that best serves its visitor and observed state. Other cases are irrelevant. Do not copy the preceding Seenry repair as a universal default.

criteria.surface_link: Make the static project preview a clearly named link to its live destination.
criteria.retain_interaction: Keep the actual embedded interactive controls usable; do not cover them with one link.
criteria.static_caption: Keep the clearly described static image without fabricating a live destination.
criteria.retain_task_controls: Keep the order task controls; do not turn the item region into an external demo link.
criteria.repair_crop: Repair source and frame sizing before changing the established navigation.
criteria.none: Evidence does not support any of these repairs; inspect first.
